panels.description: Moti leads through a mandi lane with nose low. The other four dogs mark the route behind him. Guddu follows with his permit folder and Duda rides on his shoulder. Keep the route open.
The scent trail crosses cotton bales, kinnow crates and mustard sacks. Guddu nearly walks into a tractor-trolley. Keep the upper third clear.
The pack reaches Saand’s half-built marriage-hall site. Scaffolding and the self-shaped fountain rise behind the dogs. Keep the sky clear.
Moti stops before cement bags, one ear upright. Behind the bags, a rolled corner of the stolen dhurrie is plainly visible. Keep the cement-bag area clear.
